name: ビデオ影の一貫性
description: ビデオフレーム全体で影の方向、強度、時間的一貫性を分析します。
useCase: Detecting manipulated videos through 影 behavior 異常
mechanism: Tracks 影 positions, directions, and intensities にわたる frames relative to light sources. In manipulated videos, 影s may not follow consistent physics - changing direction unnaturally, disappearing or appearing without cause, or exhibiting temporal flickering.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 72-85% on composited and manipulated videos
source: Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2010) - Exposing Digital Forgeries from 3-D Lighting Environments, ICIP
algorithm: Shadow Detection + Light Source Estimation + Temporal Consistency Verification
parameters: Shadow 閾値: 適応型, Light estimation: spherical harmonics, Consistency window: 20 frames
